dataset: Falko-MERLIN German GEC Corpus - WNUT 2018 release
change: Do not rewrite a subordinate clause when only one trailing token remains.
Do not rewrite across bitte when missing punctuation may conceal a new main clause.
limitations: Only four holdout rewrites were generated, so this is a safety signal rather than a stable population accuracy percentage.
The detector addresses one narrow verb-final pattern and does not cover general word order.
A reference-neutral rewrite is not automatically wrong because target hypotheses are not exhaustive.
The corpus is written learner German, not Egyptian Arabic-L1 spoken BPO interview German.
